description: Defines the class 'mac_test_mode_cell_decision_history' which manages decision history for MAC cell in test mode, including thread-safe read/write operations with lock management.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_cell_decision_history
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe history of MAC cell decisions in test mode, using lock-free ring buffer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe read pointer to the decision history for a given slot.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe write pointer to the decision history for a given slot.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the decision history for a specific slot.
